tools.name: get_state_water_summary
tools.description: Summarize public water systems for a whole US state: how many systems (and how many active), total population served, how many systems have current health-based violations and how many such violations are open, the counties with the most affected systems, and the state's UCMR5 PFAS sampling coverage

tools.name: get_current_health_violations
tools.description: List current (unresolved) health-based drinking water violations from EPA SDWIS: maximum contaminant level (MCL), maximum residual disinfectant level (MRDL), and treatment-technique violations whose status is Unaddressed or Addressed. Monitoring and reporting violations are excluded. Filter by state

tools.name: list_contaminants_with_violations
tools.description: List every contaminant that has at least one current health-based violation in EPA SDWIS, with the number of open violations and the number of water systems affected, most violations first. Useful for seeing which contaminants drive current US drinking water violations.

tools.name: get_system_lead_copper
tools.description: Lead and copper results for one water system by PWSID: the 90th percentile of tap samples for every reported Lead and Copper Rule monitoring period (latest first), with the lead action level (0.015 mg/L) and copper action level (1.3 mg/L) exceedance flags. tools.name: get_system_pfas
tools.description: PFAS results for one water system by PWSID from EPA's UCMR5 occurrence monitoring (2023-2025): whether the system was sampled, which of the 29 PFAS (plus lithium) were detected, detection counts, and maximum and mean detected concentrations in µg/L and ppt, with the 2024 PFAS MCLs shown as reference
